## Answers

**q01** — `POST /api/v1/memos` (proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go:1745 pattern `MemoService_CreateMemo_0`; declared in proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21)

**q02** — sqlite, mysql, postgres (store/migration/sqlite/, store/migration/mysql/, store/migration/postgres/)

**q03** — `postgres.DB` — store/db/postgres/postgres.go:16

**q04** — `APIV1Service.SignIn` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go:51 (Connect wrapper: `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn`, server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:78)

**q05** — 8: AIService, AttachmentService, AuthService, IdentityProviderService, InstanceService, MemoService, ShortcutService, UserService (proto/api/v1/{ai,attachment,auth,idp,instance,memo,shortcut,user}_service.proto:11–17)

**q06** — `memo_relation` (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:47)

**q07** — web/src/connect.ts (clients at :192–203)

**q08** — `store.Driver` — store/driver.go:10

**q09** — AIService (proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto:11; route `POST /api/v1/ai:transcribe`)

**q10** — store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql

**q11**
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70 (call at :115) — the only direct caller
- (indirect) `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20, which calls `s.CreateMemo`

**q12**
- frontend hook — web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:112 (`useMemos`) / :122 (`useInfiniteMemos`), call at :116
- client — web/src/connect.ts:197 (`memoServiceClient`)
- proto RPC — proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:29 (`ListMemos`)
- backend handler — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:178
- store method — store/memo.go:116
- dialect impl — store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57 (also postgres/memo.go:54, mysql/memo.go:65)

**q13** (files referencing `store.Memo`)
- store/memo.go, store/driver.go
- store/db/sqlite/memo.go, store/db/postgres/memo.go, store/db/mysql/memo.go
- server/router/api/v1/: memo_service.go, memo_service_converter.go, memo_update_helpers.go, memo_batch_helpers.go, memo_mention_helpers.go, memo_attachment_service.go, memo_relation_service.go, sse_event_helpers.go, common.go, user_service_notifications.go
- server/notification/email.go
- server/router/rss/rss.go
- server/runner/memopayload/runner.go

**q14** — RPCs: ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, DeleteShortcut (proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto:18,24,30,39,48). Implemented in server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:49,95,135,211,284 (Connect wrappers in connect_services.go).

**q15**
- user: `store.User` — store/user.go:29
- attachment: `store.Attachment` — store/attachment.go:16
- reaction: `store.Reaction` — store/reaction.go:7

**q16** (store/memo.go:140–158, plus API layer)
1. `memo_relation` rows where the memo is the source (`MemoID`) — store/memo.go:142
2. `memo_relation` rows where the memo is the target (`RelatedMemoID`) — store/memo.go:145
3. Attachments linked to the memo, each via `Store.DeleteAttachment` (which also deletes the stored blob/file) — store/memo.go:149–157, store/attachment.go:132–148
4. Before that, at the API layer, comment memos are recursively deleted — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:569–577
Then the `memo` row itself — store/memo.go:158.

**q17** — web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; client `memoServiceClient` (web/src/connect.ts:197)

**q18**
- store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go (`sqlite.DB`, :16)
- store/db/mysql/mysql.go (`mysql.DB`, :14)
- store/db/postgres/postgres.go (`postgres.DB`, :16)
- Factory: `NewDBDriver` — store/db/db.go:14 (switches on `profile.Driver`)

**q19**
- gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON (`/api/v1/*`) — registered in server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108 (`RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`), mounted at v1.go:126–129
- ConnectRPC (`/memos.api.v1.*`) — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40 (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`), mounted at server/router/api/v1/v1.go:139–144; method wrappers in server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go

**q20** — Mechanism: Server-Sent Events (`GET /api/v1/sse`, server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:25). Hub: server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:56 (`SSEHub`, `Broadcast` at :115), created in v1.go:57, closed in server/server.go:203–207. Broadcasting memo handlers: `CreateMemo` (memo_service.go:163), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:585), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:126), memo update via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (memo_update_helpers.go:71), reactions `UpsertMemoReaction` / `DeleteMemoReaction` (reaction_service.go:106,161).

**q21** (direct callers of `Store.GetUser`)
- `auth.Authenticator.AuthenticateByRefreshToken` — server/auth/authenticator.go:61
- `auth.Authenticator.resolveBearer` — server/auth/authenticator.go:149
- `notification.EmailDispatcher.DispatchInboxEmail` — server/notification/email.go:40
- `APIV1Service.GetInstanceAdmin` — server/router/api/v1/instance_service.go:332
- `APIV1Service.SignIn` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go:51
- `APIV1Service.fetchCurrentUser` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:246
- `APIV1Service.getLinkedSSOUser` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:150
- `APIV1Service.resolveSSOUser` — server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:19
- `ResolveUserByName` — server/router/api/v1/user_resource_name.go:49
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
- `RSSService.GetUserRSS` — server/router/rss/rss.go:111
- `Store.GetUserByPATHash` — store/user_setting.go:128

**q22** — Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15, called from server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157; it fans out through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (:48) per user webhook from `Store.GetUserWebhooks`. Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` → bounded queue → `Post`, internal/webhook/webhook.go:184,120). Signing: Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID.timestamp.body` with the `whsec_`-decoded secret, sent as `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<b64>` headers (internal/webhook/webhook.go:133–150).

**q23**
- SQL schema: store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33 (and mysql/postgres LATEST.sql)
- Go store model: store/memo.go:35
- API proto message: proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198
- Generated frontend types: web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts

**q24**
- web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178 (`useCreateMemo`, call at :183)
- web/src/connect.ts:197 (`memoServiceClient`)
- proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21 (`rpc CreateMemo`)
- server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70 (handler; `Store.CreateMemo` at :115)
- store/memo.go:109 (`Store.CreateMemo` → driver)
- store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16 (INSERT at :41) — postgres/mysql equivalents in their `memo.go`

**q25** — Engine: CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at internal/filter/engine.go:14–71 (schemas in internal/filter/schema.go, condition IR in ir.go, SQL rendering in render.go). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then rendered into a SQL fragment + args by `Program.Render`/`Engine.CompileToStatement` with `RenderOptions.Dialect` (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres`), which each driver appends into its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` (internal/filter/helpers.go:9; store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57–61, store/db/postgres/memo.go:54–58, store/db/mysql/memo.go:65–69).

**q26** — `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (explicit store-layer cascade, store/memo.go:142–158); `memo_share` via DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109, postgres/LATEST.sql:108, mysql/LATEST.sql:108) — note SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53), so that cascade is not enforced there. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545) but never deleted.

**q27** — Mechanism: the built `dist/` bundle is compiled into the binary with `go:embed` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20–21 (`//go:embed dist/*`), :41–61 (`Serve`, `StaticWithConfig`, `spaFallbackMiddleware`). Wired in server/server.go:72 (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28**
- `s3presign.Runner` — `RunOnce` once at startup, then a 12-hour `time.NewTicker` loop (server/server.go:161–171; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27–41)
That is the only background runner started (`startBackgroundRunners`, server/server.go:153–174).
Unused infra:
- `internal/scheduler` (cron scheduler, internal/scheduler/scheduler.go, doc.go) is referenced only from its own tests (internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10, integration_test.go:13) — no production wiring.
- `server/runner/memopayload.Runner`/`RunOnce` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14–72) is never invoked; only the standalone helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447.

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in web/src/connect.ts:156–178 (attached to the transport at :188; token plumbing in web/src/auth-state.ts, proactive refresh in web/src/hooks/useTokenRefreshOnFocus.ts). Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** (Authorization: Bearer, localStorage `memos_access_token`, web/src/auth-state.ts:6, connect.ts:99) refreshed via `AuthService.RefreshToken` against the HTTP-only **refresh-token cookie** (`credentials: "include"`, connect.ts:57–83; cookie `memos_refresh`, server/auth/token.go:49). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (server/auth/token.go `ParseAccessTokenV2`/`ParseRefreshToken`/`HashPersonalAccessToken`; server/auth/authenticator.go), invoked through `NewAuthInterceptor(authorizer)` / gateway middleware in server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68,137. Personal access tokens (`memos_pat_`, server/auth/token.go:52) are the third accepted credential kind for API clients.

**q30**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
Convergence: the first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48); all four then hand off to `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:184 and :120.
